summary: BW LPG filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, announcing a contract for eight 90,000 cbm Panamax VLGC newbuildings with Hyundai Heavy Industries for total consideration of approximately US$940 million. Delivery is scheduled sequentially from early 2029 to Q2 2030. This is a routine capital investment for fleet renewal, not a special situation. No stakes, premiums, or board recommendations are involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report on a shipbuilding contract.
